originality.rationale: Scientific comparison of statements, not titles: the new theorem gives the entire 651-line incidence spectrum and an explicit 14-line perfect matching for the genus-three 56-point curve. Current line-cover theory addresses asymptotic sufficiently-large fields; model and twist classification do not imply this finite exact matching. Targeted actual semantic-record queries and web literature searches did not reveal stronger coverage. The inaccessible maximal-curve classification and unindexed finite geometry are expressly retained as residual risks.

The novelty review is self-review and is not a guarantee of bibliographic completeness.

value.rationale: The unique F25-maximal genus-three Klein canonical curve is singled out by its arithmetic geometry, not parameter convenience. Asgarli et al. explicitly pose exact rational-line covering and provide asymptotic, not small-field perfect, covers. This result proves a saturated four-uniform matching of 56 points into 14 rational line sections and classifies all 651 line-section sizes, supplying a natural sharp finite extremal benchmark; the precise invariant and incidence pattern are relevant to finite-field covering methods rather than a generic mechanical table.
